description:
"Oh, for heaven's sake... I suppose I have no choice..."

Though exasperated, Manami crouches down before Yuito—who sits hunched over, looking dejected—and reaches out toward his fully erect, straining member. She has ended up in an intimate relationship with Yuito, her own daughter’s boyfriend... Even as her mind tells her she must stop, her body—flushed with heat in his embrace—proves impossible to resist. Silently apologizing to her daughter in her heart, Manami moves rhythmically atop Yuito, fully embodying the essence of a woman in the throes of desire...

"Just this once, mind you..."

The words she has uttered time and again dissolve into nothingness the moment she is pulled into his tight embrace. Stunned by how easily she gives in—a fact that leaves even her own self bewildered—Manami finds herself, once again today, clinging to Yuito and crying out in pleasure...

(Source: Getchu, translated)
